disabled._reason: Root cause of the old status=99 failures found 2026-09-12: 'goods_query' is the qyb (enterprise) edition method name; our WdtClient hits the qjb (flagship) gateway. Correct flagship method is goods.Goods.queryWithSpec. Live probe also showed the method REQUIRES start_time/end_time params with windows of at most 30 days (empty params -> status 100), so time_boxed must stay true. Kept disabled: dim_product is sourced directly by common/public_data/product_catalog.py, and this generic pipeline splits windows by the global 50-minute window_minutes, which is a poor fit for a rarely-changing catalog; re-enable only if the goods catalog also needs to land in wdt_records.
